capabilities: copy file metadata, such as creation time, to the clipboard
insert copied metadata into the active file name
disambiguation: Not a frontmatter or properties copier; it copies file metadata like creation time, not note properties.
extras: Detailed usage documentation lives on an external documentation site; the README also requests GitHub stars and sponsorships.
motivation: The author built it because adding a Zettelkasten timestamp to file names is inconvenient on mobile, requiring manual renaming when moving to desktop.
problem: Notes created quickly on Obsidian Mobile often lack a Zettelkasten timestamp in their name, and renaming them later on desktop is tedious.
summary: Utility that copies file metadata such as creation time to the clipboard and can append it to the active file name.
